viewing_check: Check the top seam and cap for rust-through and whether the cap is seized, the base rim rust, and the back for dents not shown in the photos. The three exact-match sales are all Burns & Co hammer prices (A$210 to A$450, Jun to Oct 2025), two at their premium Next Level sales, condition not stated. No Supra pint sold on eBay AU in the last ~90 days. Burns & Co also catalogued two more Supra pints for their 21 Aug 2025 Next Level sale (lots 1627 and 1680 in https://burnsandcoauctions.com.au/wp-content/uploads/Print-Catalogue-28.pdf); I couldn't find those results. eBay AU now builds a buyer protection fee into displayed prices for private sellers (item 920003022225 showed A$159.70 incl. A$9.70), so eBay prices here are what buyers paid, not what sellers got.
